node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal c2 (2,0,2) ramified-defect exclusion
node.closure: exclusion of the ramified source-line square fiber in the diagonal (2,0,2) row by the complete-source defect budget
node.statement: In the source-line branch of the diagonal (a,b,c)=(2,0,2) row, the forced square common-K fiber cannot be the ramified orbit of W=X^2. The two reciprocal ramified fibers contribute two distinct doubled star vertices, while the eight reduced stars over the remaining four common-K labels occupy at most six J_0 edges; their defect costs are at least two and two, contradicting the complete-source budget three. Hence every surviving source-line packet in this row has the unramified 4/3-dimensional coefficient cut. The row and biquadratic branch remain open.
